chemotaxis-motility/kstrail.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Spontaneous crescent swimmers (spot -> ring -> crescent). chi_h=0 gives static spots. Passes dt/2 and 2x resolution. Coarsens by t=1800. L3 Weak. Known drift-bifurcation physics. No Laplacian-only control.

chemotaxis-motility/ecology.note: FINAL (r3). Moved from L5[L2] low (r1, provisional). The matched decomposition it was provisional on ran in evopursuit, not here. Prey-predator composites, contact 0.93-0.96 vs null ~0.33. L5 Weak. Superseded by evopursuit.

chemotaxis-motility/toxforage.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Toxic self-trail acts as size control and keeps 9-14 swimmers with turnover. L4c Weak (near-Supported; n=0 fork on 1 seed). L4a Weak.

chemotaxis-motility/pursuit.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Non-reciprocal cross-taxis binds chaser-fleer composites; the 2x2 ablation shows pursuit binds and evasion shapes the bond. L5 Weak (conserved species).

autopoiesis/phase_membrane.note: FINAL (r3). Forms from noise. Links adsorbed at the Allen-Cahn wall make an L ring 2.1-2.5x the core and about 0 outside. Both daughters carry a complete ring (to gen 3), with 9-12 persistent splits in 3 seeds, and the ring and gen 3 survive dt/2 and 2x resolution. New in r3: a matched chi=0 ablation (same grid, 8000 t, seeds 0-2) removes the ring (rim/core 1.51-1.72 -> 1.12-1.14). The ring also does work: the cells are about 2x larger and divide about 3x less (15-17 vs 42-43 cells, 9-12 vs 26-32 persistent splits). It is not needed for viability. L builds the body through a(L-theta), so the ring acts as a growth front. Repair is reported separately (phase_membrane_damage_mature). Division-axis histograms were never delivered.

autopoiesis/phase_swimdiv.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. The lab's first dividing swimmers: crescents with depletion wakes divide repeatedly (10 and 5 divisions on judge seeds 11 and 12; segments up to 7.9 BL), and this reproduces with an isotropic stencil. Propulsion is a hand-coded per-body rigid drift, and headings cluster on lattice diagonals in some seeds. L3 Weak.

autopoiesis/phase_protocell_noise.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Walled droplets form from noise and divide by central starvation: 42-46 cells, 28-33 persistent splits, gen 3-4, in 3 seeds plus seed 11. dt/2 and 2x resolution match. The wall is 4phi(1-phi), a contour, and L is a filled disk, so L3 is Weak. L4a is Weak (near-Supported; one seed). Close to Gray-Scott mitosis and Zwicker droplets.

autopoiesis/phase_kinds.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. A faster K2 replaces K1 and divisions breed true, but the sweep is mostly contagion: 45 intact cells were converted against 8 mutations, and K2 still sweeps with mutation off. L7 Weak.

autopoiesis/phase_trait.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. The growth-rate trait drifts toward 0.16-0.18 from both starts but does not converge. There is no neutral arm, and the population is frozen after about 12k. L7 Weak.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-turn.note: RETRACTED (r2), final. The waste was gated by cargo through a channel-index bug, and every founder was planted with q=1.2. Its gen 5/6/4 is colonization of a box emptied by poisoned founders, by 2 survivors. With m-gated waste the world goes extinct by t~32. Superseded by xcell-evo2.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-a.note: FINAL (unchanged since r1). m4 gliders (8/8 cells, 7.9-8.6 body lengths, 3 seeds) with a band-deposited membrane ring (m 0.55 at the rim, 0.22 at the centre, ~0 outside). The ring holds a fast D=4 cargo: 1.24 at the centre vs 0.43 with the gate off, dt-converged. The body is exactly m4 (K=0), so the compartment is passive. Part of m is a trailing wake. The gate-off control keeps D=4, not a lowered uniform D. L4a Weak: one cell, 29.6% erased. Biologist dissent: L3 Weak.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-her.note: FINAL (r3). Two planted kinds breed true: 46 divisions, 0 mixed, 0 switches. Removing the membrane gate on h erases every on-lineage while body and division are unchanged (3 judges). kb -10% breaks it. In r3 the heredity was shown to be regime-conditional: the same planted, cell-filling marker in the sister genome xcell-evo2-N under free-space, faster fission fails like a kicked one (skeptic, seed 11). The h bridge at the pinch neck is also seen here, but both remnants regrow. Untested candidates: the waste channel and division speed. There is no resolved Laplacian twin in this regime, so beyond-diffusion stays 1. L6 Weak (one counted generation). L7 Contradicted. The thread's showcase world.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-div.note: FINAL (unchanged since r1). Membrane-ringed cells divide by Gray-Scott-class RD, still giving 8 splits with the gate off: 13/15/15 splits, then a frozen lattice under a global cap by t~200. L6 Weak (max gen 2 from planted founders). Passes dt/2 and dx 0.33. A single-seed noise screen forms ~26 ringed cells.

flow-lenia/fl_forager.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. One 12x12 noise patch becomes 8-14 motile crescent foragers with food-depletion wakes, with 0 nucleations in 4 seeds and 2-generation chains in seeds 1, 2 and 11. Propulsion is emergent (the parent rule glides without food). At 2x resolution the gliders and division hold, but crescents become ring-in-halo bodies. Fission-fusion: merges are about 80% of splits, so lineages are reticulate. L4c, L5 and L3 Weak. The r3 gene2 seed-0 sheet (t=104-944) shows the same gliders. The thread's best world and its best PhySim candidate (exact food+matter ledger).

flow-lenia/fl_cells.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Three-channel cells: an A0 core, a 1.5-px A1 ring that is 0 inside and out, and A2 shells. Radii converge at 2x resolution. 38-44% cuts re-form ring and crown against twins on 3 seeds, but the cells end smaller with a hollow core (generic re-condensation). Static, one cell per planted patch. Close to the Particle Lenia control.

flow-lenia/fl_morph257.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Orange rings and cyan crescents sort out from one patch; crescents cup rings for 500-650 t. 20/30 composite divisions give one daughter of each kind. One seed, so L5, L4b and L6 are Weak. Never followed up.

flow-lenia/fl_forager_mut.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Body-scale parameter mutations give new persistent morphs, but the identical-event neutral twin shows as much clade turnover. One pair. L6 and L7 Weak. The founder tournament (fl_forager_evo, L2) was a coin flip: L7 Contradicted.

flow-lenia/fl_cells_food.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. A binucleate cell, then a 6-8-compartment 'morula', then A1 dots tile the domain. 257 nucleations, so the 'spores' condense from shed matter. L6[L3] Contradicted; L3 Weak. One seed.

particle-life/sporecell.note: Unchanged from r1: cells form spontaneously from ~20 random catalyst particles and shed single-particle spores that grow into parent-size daughters (3 seeds plus skeptic seed 11), then freeze into a ~40-cell lattice. L3, L4a, L4c and L6[L2] Weak. New in r2: the same engine and dt (rep=10, ff=10, dt=0.02) fail dt convergence. Free spores are 127/40/6 and cells at t=200 are 24/14/5 at dt 0.02/0.01/0.005, so the spore reproduction rate is numerical heating (numerical validity 0).

particle-life/sporecell-gene.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Within-cell Janus selection of a looser mutant against a neutral control (3 seeds). L7 Contradicted: purity 0.55-0.88. L6[L2] Weak (ratchet lineage).

particle-life/plife-m2.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Known Mohr/Ventrella concentric type-sorted cells, used as calibration (3 seeds, short run, no dt check). The movers at 8.9-13.2 BL were never examined: an open L4b lead for the brief's non-reciprocal line.

lenia-multichannel/mcfd-MIRd.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Planted MIRd+ fed by regrowing food with maintenance decay 0.03. A judge's dense rerun shows binary fissions after a trough (4->17 cells in ~100 t), with daughters re-forming core, cap and dots. Food competition sets the dynamics: decay 0/0.01/0.03 gives dormant/static/boom-bust. The cycle is intermittent, not regular: damped at 192², and extinct at dt/2 in 1/2 seeds. L3 Weak (1-2 px halo dots). Showcase movie movies/showcase.mp4 (seed 2, 128², t 0-1400).

lenia-multichannel/mcf-MIRd.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Chan's planted replicator with build-from-food: 6 persistent splits, gen 3 (seeds 0 and 2). Norefill is extinct in 3/3 seeds against 11-16 survivors with refill. L5 Weak. Replication itself is Chan's result.

lenia-multichannel/mcf-fastcell.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Planted Chan 'fast cell' gliders (8-15 BL) carve food wakes. Real A0 shell at r 14-22 with A0=0 inside r<8. Norefill leaves 0/0/1 survivors vs 3/4/3. Spontaneity 0; no dt/R test.

lenia-multichannel/r-two56.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. 2/420 random 2-channel rules give cells with a white centre, cyan core and orange cog shell. They form from noise in 6 seeds, survive dt/2 and R=15/20, and the ring-kernel set-point shell is backed by ablations. Static, with no turnover. L4a Contradicted. The r3 food variant is listed separately (rf-two56-mu0.01).

lenia-multichannel/r-two-s1-60.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Known single-channel C-glider class (the second channel is dead; constant-k5 keeps the glider). Grid-aligned bricks.

active-droplets/ad5-evolve.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Catalyst alleles arise by mutation during the run, breed true, and faster alleles out-divide a sterile ancestor (6+6 seeds, p about 0.001; the ancestor-matched neutral gives 0 divisions). It is a colonization-only race with 0 deaths. Mutation is a half-droplet transplant, and 1-2 of 6 divisions gave an off-kind daughter. The line was closed in r2 in favour of ad7, whose trait is not fitness itself.

active-droplets/ad3-membrane (+ ad3s-sou.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. A self-made psi shell in its own channel wraps every daughter and forms from psi=0 in 9/9 runs. It is inert (no back-reaction) and 1-2 px wide. Superseded by ad7, where the same shell does work.

active-droplets/ad1-fuel.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Planted disks hollow into rings that break up, then divide by dumbbell pinch: gen 2-4 and 12-16 persistent splits. Three judges' seed-11 reruns match, and dt/2 and dx=0.5 converge. This is Gray-Scott mitosis in a Cahn-Hilliard body: Laplacian-only twins also divide. L4c Weak. Uniform starts go extinct.

active-droplets/ad4-protocell.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r1. Two planted catalyst kinds with the inert shell breed true, but max gen is 2 (L6 Weak) and the population is frozen by t of about 8000. Superseded by ad5.

fisim-beyond-laplacian/xcell-evo2-S.note: FINAL (r3). S/N identical-event twins, 3+3 seeds, T=2000. S0 reaches gen 6 (11 persistent splits, 0 merges) and N1 gen 4, but only 2/6 runs reach gen>=3. Bodies are planted, every death is an imposed disk erasure, and division is Gray-Scott-class. In the r3 heredity assay (22 runs) on the N genome, every arm gives 8-11 ringed fissions per run. L7 Contradicted: no arisen mark ever reached both daughters, gated or ungated, including a resolved Dh 0.02 arm at dx=0.25 (reproduced on seed 11). The marker is stranded in the neck as the body grows out from under it. The gate keeps it in one daughter in 1 of 4 seeds (retention, not heredity). L3 qualifier: band ring plus the gate ablation in the assay; the skeptic dissents (Weak). Beyond-diffusion 1.

autopoiesis/membrane_kinds.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. The committee's leaky-channel test, and the source of the infection law: with any catalyst leak and c2>c1, a trace becomes a takeover. Conversions exceed mutations in 6/6 B/B' runs, and K2 rises by converting a frozen lattice. L7 Contradicted. L5[L3] Weak (parasite collapse, metrics only). The L6[L3] belongs to the base phase_membrane cells. Superseded by membrane_evo (arm E), which closed the channel.

autopoiesis/motile_trait_tox.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. Heritable phoretic mobility with a co-mutated neutral tag under toxic self-waste (kd=0.02). Crescents travel 11-25 BL. mu-tag is +0.08..+1.33 in 5/5 surviving seeds, but populations are 2-8 cells, the sign reverses at kd 0.018, and seed 11 reads -0.36. L6 Weak and L7[L2] Weak. Propulsion is a designed per-body drift.

autopoiesis/motile_trait.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. kd=0 twin of motile_trait_tox: 29 persistent splits, gen 4, 1 merge per 44 splits. It freezes into a lattice by about 25k. L7[L2] Weak: mu ends below the neutral tag in 5/5 dense populations, but there are no per-cell births or deaths by mu, and dt/2 matches only the endpoint.

chemotaxis-motility/evopursuit.note: Prey are motile crescents that divide, each with a predator riding in its concave rear. A behavioural evasion allele B (stronger flight from the predator signal, 15% growth cost) arises by mutation and sweeps: A/B bodies at t=1500 are 0/29, 0/30, 0/34. It does not sweep in the ancestor-matched neutral arm (e=cost=0: 0-1 B, prey -95%) or the predator-free arm (0 B), each over 3 seeds. dt/2 gives A1/B33, and the skeptic's seed-11 rerun at 128² reproduces. L5 Supported for A prey (matched, negative). For B prey the sign flips: at t=1500 B prey with predators total 1458-1622 against 586-769 for predator-free prey (start 1283), so 'rescue from predation' is withdrawn pending fixed-allele escort arms. L6 Weak in this world: labkit fuses species (0 splits, 796-1076 nucleations), and prey births are inferred, not tracked. L7 Weak (near-Supported): B keeps multiplying after A is extinct, but there is no per-kind birth/death/conversion ledger, the radius-4 swap converts whole bodies, and the neutral arm is not an identical-event twin. No resolution test. Beyond-diffusion leverage is at most 1.

chemotaxis-motility/swimfission.note: FINAL (r3), rung unchanged since r2. Waist-pinch fission into equal swimming ovals. Strict largest-parent rule: 10/10/15 clean fissions and gen 3/3/3. dt/2 gives gen 3 with 12 fissions, and the first five fission times are identical. Reticulate: merges 56/56/45 > splits 45/39/31. The 'strict' strips are byte-identical to the r2 founder-fission strips, so deepest-generation strips are not shown. 6/47 events have a daughter heavier than its parent. No resolution change. L4c Weak.

chemotaxis-motility/swimevo.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. Growth-rate allele with ~10 bodies per run and no ledger. L7 Weak. Superseded by evopursuit.

lenia-multichannel/mca-MIRd.note: FINAL (r3); L7 Not tested (r2) -> Weak (r3). This is the committee's branch-point assay. 12 mature isolated cells from 2 neutral runs (192², decay 0.03, mutation off) were each flipped whole (coverage 1.0) and run 500 t under S (EFF 0.15) and N from the identical state. S>N in 10/10 informative pairs; the 2 smallest starts (0.012, 0.014) were lost in both arms. S ends at allele-1 fraction 0.40-0.72 with 8-22 pure cells, N at 0-0.56 with 0-8. Ledger (3 points x S/N): allele-1 deaths/divisions are 0.30-0.43 under S vs 0.63-0.78 for allele 0, and matched under N (0.46-0.65). Net conversions +1 to +3 against net allele-1 births +36 to +55, so the sweep is not contagion. It fails the L7 bar on four counts. (1) 47% pure allele-1 divisions (99/211 S, 27/57 N), against a 90% bar. (2) Gross living-cell conversions of 7-15 per S run against 1 mutation. (3) Imposed variation. (4) Isolated founders only: the skeptic's contact founder was lost in both arms. Further caveats: the ledger is not merge-aware (allele 0 logs 133 divisions and 83 deaths in ~18 cells), labkit reads gen <=1 with merge/split 0.56-0.66, and S raises population size (27.5 vs 18.1). The seed-0 S sheet sets into a static allele-1 lattice by t~350-500 (candidate self-dormancy). Per-body retry B5 coded, unreported. Same 6 states, old operator (partial flips 0.50-0.79): lost 9/12 arm-runs vs 1/12 for whole-body flips (coverage law).

lenia-multichannel/mcg-MIRd (+ mcg-MIRd-.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. Continuous yield trait with blur inheritance, which blends at contacts. L7 Weak. Two-sided yield: L7 Contradicted. Eco-evolutionary freeze Weak (no Jensen control); r3's mca branch lattice is a second instance.

flow-lenia/fl_forager_gene.note: FINAL (r3). The r2 rate-matched run (p=0.021; in seed 3 an undivided cell is taken over after a mutation patch). L7 Weak (low) in r2 -> Contradicted, superseded by the r3 identical-event audit in fl_forager_gene2.

flow-lenia/fl_predator.note: FINAL (r3). L5 'Weak (near-Supported)' (r2) -> Weak. Prey gliders plus predators that convert overlapped prey mass (conserving mass) and decay to food. Chase and flee are imposed sigma-12 blurred-field sensing. Engulfment repeats: seed 0 #355/#395/#497, and skeptic seed 12 at t=304/536/800. Coexistence survives the early predator crash in 4/5 seeds (0, 1, 2, 12), but seed 12 is truncated at t=880 and seed 11 loses its predators at t~704. 1 of 9 parameter points coexists. Matched arms exist only on seed 11: flee=0 kills both species, chase=0 kills the predators sooner (t~376 vs 704). The prey-only arm is not mass-matched: the +274 prey gap is about the 277 units of predator mass, so the predators' effect on prey is ~0 or positive there, a sign flip. L4b holds for prey only (predators have 0 moving tracks). L4c Weak (by construction). No resolution test. Showcase: movies/showcase.mp4 (192^2, seed 0). fl_predator_gene: L7 Contradicted (r2).

particle-life/sporecell2-sel.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. L7[L2] Weak (the mix is fixed during colonization; fails at dt 0.015/0.01 and on seed 11). L6[L2] Weak. [L3] Contradicted. Numerical validity 0. The converged r3 twin (sporecell3-det) does not rescue it.

particle-life/sporecell2-gate (gate_beta.note: Food mobility is gated by membrane density, D_F exp(-beta nM). Founders keep thick 2-layer M rings (membrane fraction 0.6-0.78) through t~28-136 in 3 seeds, then one founder per seed bursts into a spore cloud that colonizes the box with bare cells: a striking but non-repeating life cycle (screens/lifecycle_poster.png). L6[L3] Contradicted: every daughter is bare. L6[L2] Weak: one burst per seed, a ratcheting lineage, no dt test. L3 Weak: a conditional food-contact layer found only on founders. L4a Weak: in D_gate.png the cut matter becomes food at the wound, the control is a cell of the other kind, and only one seed was run. Custom screens only, no pack.

particle-life/sporecell2-lysis (half/hal.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2; dt=0.02 map only. Matched arms on 3/3 seeds: + for kind 1, - for kind 0, and a rare killer loses. Kinds are planted, the arms are not event-matched, and there is no invasion test. Never rerun at the step-safe step, where r3's control shows that the reproduction it rests on vanishes. No pack.

active-droplets/ad7-gated family (ad7t-t.world: ad7-gated family (ad7t-thick, ad7-gated-d4; neutral arms ad7tn-neutral, ad7n-neutral-d4)
active-droplets/ad7-gated family (ad7t-t.note: The self-made amphiphile shell psi (own production prod*kp, chi-drift transport, decay) now gates fuel (Du e^{-0.5psi}) and catalyst (Dc e^{-3psi}); alleles differ only in shell output kp. One operator gives a permeability/retention trade-off: bc=0 at kp=0.5 gives 3 static blobs vs 12, and bu=0 at kp=4 gives 12 vs 6 (1 seed each). The landscape peaks at kp 0.5-1.5 (seeds 0-1; t=8000 colonization counts). Phenotypes read in single frames (seed1 protocells.png): rimless leaky kp=0 blobs, thin-rimmed dividing kp=0.5-1.5 cells, small thick-walled kp=4 cells. Skeptic's seed-11 rerun: psi rim/core 4.4, rim/outside 11.9 (26/29). L6: seed0 gen 4, 7 persistent splits, 0 merges; gen>=3 in 4/9 selection runs; no birth strips; planted founders. L7[L3] Weak: membrane mutants out-multiply the slow ancestor in 6/6 seed pairs (36 vs 21 and 23 vs 10 droplets), but the neutral intermediate share is 12/21 (57%), not the reported 9/21; per-seed shares overlap (75/91/46 vs 67/50/57%) and the ancestor share matches neutral (22 vs 24%). About 40 r=5 patch flips vs 6-9 splits per run, intact droplets relabelled, off-kind daughters, no ledger, not identical-event twins. L4c Weak (by construction, no v2 test). dt/2 exact; at dx=0.5 kp=4 area -30% and the shell is ~2 px wide at both resolutions (grid-set). R arm (CH->linear at D=M, 1 seed): kp=0.5 stops dividing (5 vs 12), the thread's first hint that CH does work. Supersedes ad3-membrane as the thread's L3 world.

autopoiesis/membrane_evo (twin / membran.note: FINAL (r3), new. This is the committee's arm E: phase_membrane cells from noise, two catalyst kinds differing only in link yield b2 (c2=c1), and a sealed catalyst channel (min face gate plus fast decay outside bodies). Whole-cell flips, a co-mutated neutral tag and r=14 disk deaths are drawn from one state-independent RNG, so each seed has an identical-event twin. 10 seeds x 3 arms (runs/evo_hi). Final K2 biomass share: up 0.85-0.97 in 8/10 seeds, twin 0-0.46, down <=0.04. Hygiene: conversions <= flips in 30/30 runs, 1 first acquisition, 4 off-kind daughters. dt/2 holds on 2 seeds, and the skeptic reproduced the sweep on seed 11 (share 0.88). The down arm purges K2 by intrinsic deaths (46 vs 6 in the twin). It is near-lethal. Disturbance-mediated: the up sweep runs through K2 births (12-45 vs 0-14), mostly fragments cut by the disk that reseal and regrow (30/38 on s4 and 43/43 on s11 are disk-associated, 0 spontaneous on s11). The disk is 2.4x a median K1 cell and erases each pixel about 11x per run. Disk deaths are K1 19-31 vs K2 0-8 (a size refuge). The sweep goes through births in 8/10 seeds and wins by counts in 7/10. In batch 1 (r_death 10, p 0.003), up has fewer K2 cells in 5/5. The births are not merge-aware, the researcher shipped no birth strips, and the selected kind's lineage reaches gen 2 with 3 persistent splits. The [L3] bracket is borderline: the skeptic's phi>1/2 profiles give L rim/core of about 2.0, while labkit's aggregate reads 1.33-1.43 (ring-split bodies). Cells are axis-faceted (anisotropy 0.20-0.24), with no resolution test. The skeptic dissents (L7 Weak).

autopoiesis/phase_membrane mature damage.note: FINAL (r3); replaces the r1 L4a credit (medium under v1). labkit v0.2 rim cuts on mature cells, 3 seeds, with same-seed undamaged twins. s2: a central 41% cut on a round cell (age 69 frames, aspect 1.04) closes and re-rings by t=6600, then grows and divides. s0: a 21% nick recovers to 0.99x. s1: the target merged into a neighbour. Skeptic's branched twin on seed 11 (34-35% cuts): one target reaches 0.98 of its twin, the other 0.81-0.87. damage.png compares the target with a different cell. The cells grow continuously, so 'mature' is ill-defined. Repair is automatic (curvature flow). Two of three judges rated it Weak.

autopoiesis/phase_membrane_chi0.note: FINAL (r3), new. Control for phase_membrane with chi=0 (no link adsorption). Noise gives about 42 small round cells dividing by dumbbell pinches: 26-32 persistent splits, gen 2-4, merge/split 0.03-0.09, 3 seeds. The population ends in a near-hexagonal frozen lattice. L fills the body (rim/core 1.12-1.14), so L3 is Contradicted, as intended. In effect this is phase_protocell_noise. No birth strips.

lenia-multichannel/rf-two56-mu0.01.note: FINAL (r3), new. r-two56 on build-from-food with maintenance decay 0.01 (192²). Shelled cog cells form from noise in 4/4 seeds: 3 researcher seeds plus skeptic seed 11, with 7/3/2 survivors to t=300. Skeptic radial: A0 ~1 to rho 0.55; A1 ~0 at rho 0.25-0.55 and ~0.9 at rho 0.75-1.0 (rim/out 78). labkit's band test fails (A1 rim/core 1.24) only because of a central A1 dot. Static fixed points with attrition. Survivors sit in shallow food wells (F ~0.7 at the centre vs 0.9 at 2.5 R; mean food 0.99). Decay 0.03 leaves <=1 cell. L4c Not tested: no fork, no local cut, no flux budget. One unlabelled researcher screen, no researcher pack, and no resolution check on the fed variant (base r-two56 passed dt/2 and R=15/20).

chemotaxis-motility/evopursuit (+ arms_*.note: FINAL (r3). Arms (m=0, 160², t=1500, 3 seeds each): prey mass t1500/t150 is B+pred 1.28-1.32, B+escort 2.43-2.54, B alone 0.36-0.54, A+pred 0.11-0.15, A+escort 1.22-1.62, A alone 0.41-0.76. Predators reach 1.75-1.88x on B and 0.20-0.32x on A. The predator's net effect is positive on B (2.4-3.5x prey alone) and lethal on A (0.15-0.36x). In the arms_B_pred_s0 sheet, ~30-35 crescents each cup a predator. Skeptic seed 11 at 96²: B+esc 2.19 > B+pred 1.55 > B alone 0.57, dt/2 holds, clip mass <=0.005. B beats A mainly by retention under consumption (5.8-6.2x), with a smaller chase gain (1.7-2.8x). Partner abundance is unmatched. L6 Weak and L7 Weak (both near-Supported): 23 clean B fission events (strict gen 3/2/4) vs 28 A->B conversions, net conversion +5 against ~90 B bodies gained, 158 B deaths replaced mostly by unclassified splits. preytrack credits near-contacts as daughters, about half of the random birth strips involve a second body, there is no identical-event twin, and the 49-px swap is about the size of a body. No resolution change. Beyond-diffusion 1. L3 Contradicted.

active-droplets/ad7-gated family (ad7t-t.world: ad7-gated family (ad7t-thick, ad7-gated-d4; neutral arms ad7tn-neutral, ad7n-neutral-d4; ad9-ledger is its harmonic-gate variant)
active-droplets/ad7-gated family (ad7t-t.note: FINAL (r3), unchanged since r2. The self-made amphiphile shell psi (own production kp*prod, chi-drift transport, decay) gates fuel weakly and catalyst strongly. Alleles differ only in shell output kp, which gives a permeability/retention trade-off with an interior optimum: bc=0 gives 3 static blobs vs 12, and bu=0 gives 12 vs 6 (1 seed each). The r2 skeptic's radial gives rim/core 4.4 and rim/out 11.9. In r3 ad9 reproduces the optimum under harmonic face means on 3 seeds plus judge seed 11.
